name: Jonas Myklebost
headline: EnvisionTech | Investment Principal
summary:
Experience from investment management and management advisory with a passion and demonstrated history of working on the global energy transformation. 

Pay excellent attention to detail to ensure work is produced to the highest of standards and completed fully. Extended international experience from studying and working in Germany, Norway, Scotland and South-Korea. Thrives in both team and individual work settings.

positions.title: Investment Principal
positions.description: EnvisionTech is an active owner fund investing in Nordic growth stage energy efficiency tech companies. We focus on companies with a positive ROI that disrupt conventional solutions within three main investment themes: Ocean space, electrification and transition accelleration. Applying a private equity approach to the scale-up phase, we partner with entrepreneurial management teams and owners to create value and drive change through active ownership and strategic exits.
